properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 25 at 1:51AM PST until November 27 at 4:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal
flooding expected. For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking
waves of 6-8 feet, sets up to 10-12 feet along west-facing
beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, now through 1 PM PST
Friday. For the High Surf Advisory, from 1 PM today to 4 AM PST
Friday. Most susceptible time of flooding will be around the
time of the morning high tide, with peak tides trending from 8
AM today to 10 AM on Friday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur.
Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and localized beach
erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...King tides peak through Thursday at 7.9-
8.3 feet, likely breaking the all-time tidal records set back in
late October. Background surf on top of the tides will remain
around 3-6 feet this morning. A long period west swell arrives
late this afternoon and will bring elevated to high surf by
Thursday morning's high tide. Breaking waves may reach 6-8 feet
with local sets up to 10-12 feet on west-facing beaches. Surf
lowers to 5-7 feet by Friday morning's high tide.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.
